questions.q: On an NFPA 704 'Fire Diamond', what does the **blue** quadrant represent?
questions.explain: The NFPA 704 diamond uses colors to denote hazards: Blue = Health, Red = Flammability, Yellow = Instability/Reactivity, and White = Special Hazards.
